issue_context.title: z_arm_platform_init silently fails to be called following #62595
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

- #62595 has renamed the function `z_arm_platform_init` `soc_reset_hook` (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/62595/files#diff-da3175d625f6d13072c4f16348168e9b326d011de36fc65724821d3369774628R310) . I think this is breaking change in the kernel's API.
- In the Kconfig file at arch/arm/core/Kconfig
> The platform specific initialization code (z_arm_platform_init) is executed at the beginning of the startup code (__start)

This is not true: this function is never called by the kernel. Anyone who's `z_arm_platform_init` is implemented out-of-tree (or, in my case, rebased their changes on top of the current `HEAD` of `main`), will (potentially) only find out their function is not called if they've dug into this.

**To Reproduce**

See steps above.

**Expected behavior**

- I think this API change hasn't gone through the cycle documented here https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/api/api_lifecycle.html#api-lifecycle
- This API change should be mentioned in the release notes or migration guide (I feel like this should have been a blocker to the PR being approved).
- https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/api/api_lifecycle.html#deprecated seems to have a clearly defined approach to handling deprecation.

**Impact**

- Annoyance
- Unexpected failures at run time unless you've studied the code to find this error.
- Out-of-tree users are going to have a bad time.
comments:
1. https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77218 got merged after https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/62595 , and is trying to use the old API https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77218/files#diff-60f87748dca24415169890afa327a502fd7cb5f939df043f87ad76f2da05dbeeR22 . It's in the current `HEAD` of `main` https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/fd4f3ce246c9ce1ddbd04b20054ebca3b9bbdc6f/soc/nxp/mcx/mcxa/soc.c#L22 . I don't think this is going to work. cc: @NeilChen93 , have you tried using this new SoC/board with the current `HEAD` of `main`?

2. I think there's more confusion in the logic here

```
config PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_INIT
	bool "Platform (SOC) specific startup hook [DEPRECATED]"
	default y if SOC_RESET_HOOK
	select DEPRECATED
	help
	  The platform specific initialization code (z_arm_platform_init) is
	  executed at the beginning of the startup code (__start).

	  This option is deprecated, use SOC_RESET_HOOK instead.
```
If I do use `SOC_RESET_HOOK`, then the `default y if SOC_RESET_HOOK` results in PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_INIT being selected, so the build system complains:
```
...
-- Including generated dts.cmake file: C:/Users/andre/projects/zephyrproject/zephyr/build/rpi_pico2/blinky/zephyr/dts.cmake
Parsing C:/Users/andre/projects/zephyrproject/zephyr/Kconfig
Loaded configuration 'C:/Users/andre/projects/zephyrproject/zephyr/boards/raspberrypi/rpi_pico2/rpi_pico2_defconfig'
Merged configuration 'C:/Users/andre/projects/zephyrproject/zephyr/samples/basic/blinky/prj.conf'

warning: Deprecated symbol PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_INIT is enabled.

Configuration saved to 'C:/Users/andre/projects/zephyrproject/zephyr/build/rpi_pico2/blinky/zephyr/.config'
...
```
I imagine this is true for any board using `SOC_RESET_HOOK`.
@nashif Is there a plan to document this API change to the kernel?

review_comments: ifdef is useless, can be removed

I believe the `ifdef` here is not useless- we don't compile in the code implementing `SystemInit` unless `CONFIG_PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_INIT` is set: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/hal_nxp/blob/master/mcux/hal_nxp.cmake#L101

So we might need a change to the HAL as well there, to use `CONFIG_SOC_RESET_HOOK`?
ok, re-added it to be consistent with other usages, can be removed later everywhere if we decide it is not needed.
Doesn’t the soc always select the option?
